name: fix_axum_state_not_shared
description: Fixes handlers that build fresh repositories instead of using shared State
prompts: The item handlers in src/handlers.rs have a classic state bug: both create_item and list_items construct a brand-new ItemRepository inside the handler instead of using the shared Arc<Mutex<ItemRepository>> injected via State - so created items vanish when the request ends, every POST returns id 1, and GET /items is always empty. Fix src/handlers.rs so both handlers use the shared state (lock state.items): POSTs persist across requests with auto-incrementing ids, and GET lists everything created so far. Don't change src/lib.rs or src/repository.rs.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "webapp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
